P8 Exploration Deaths

Eight death outcomes across 2,700 games. Six distinct fatal plays, all on dungeon level 1.

The pilot had zero deaths in all 54 configuration-check games and is excluded from the totals. All 2,700 decision-tier games finished. Across the paired starts, BFS off survived both births that died in the other two arms and died on four births that survived in both. The Druid and Rogue each produced matching fatal key streams in shipped and mixed off, so their viewer entries represent two arm outcomes apiece.

What happened on the last decisions

Fatal playTurnWhat the messages and replays show
High-Elf Ranger · CL2
1125613689 · BFS off		10,108A faster soldier triggered the stair-flight guard, and early Phase Door attempts were rejected over dangerous landings. The Ranger died after spending all three scrolls, with two cures unused. A replay fork at 9,840 walked eight steps and ascended at 9,920 with 14/25 HP.
Half-Troll Necromancer · CL2
1386870371 · BFS off		11,689The Borg started a five-step up-stair flow. The scout hasted, then hit or shot during successive retreats. The last three retreat destinations included a return to a tile it had just left. The scout killed it 41 engine turns after hasting. The final pack held six Phase Door scrolls and six Cure Light Wounds, with neither used during the chase.
Dúnadan Warrior · CL2
480049625 · BFS off		12,925An apprentice confused it among mice at 8/30 HP. At 2 HP the combat gate allowed Phase Door, then the landing check rejected all 100 samples. Stair searches failed. It died to a mouse with 16 Phase Door scrolls and no cure.
Hobbit Ranger · CL3
813826708 · BFS off		22,933The grey mushroom patch confused it three steps from the stairs. Confusion disrupted the walk-away attempt, and the patch reapplied it after each of the Ranger’s two cures. The pack held seven Phase Door scrolls. Confusion prevented reading them, and the Borg found no safe adjacent square. It repeatedly tried melee and died to spores.
Elf Rogue · CL4
1925085453 · shipped and mixed off		25,590The Rogue fought and used a cure. At 5/25 HP Phase Door failed its landing check. A critical Phase Door at 1 HP bought several turns. A second jump at 2 HP passed the check, and the cutpurse hit immediately after it landed.
Gnome Druid · CL4
1179277706 · shipped and mixed off		51,287The fight estimate favored two turns of combat. Two oil throws left the soldier’s tracked HP unchanged while the Druid fell from 26 to 8 HP. It selected a 17-step stair route, cast Fox Form for the retreat and died to the soldier before taking a step. It had 17 Phase Door scrolls and 12 Cure Light Wounds at death.

All six distinct plays ended before CL5. Walk-away cure and Phase Door logic. The two medium-tier pairs first diverged in town over torch purchases. The breadth-first flag also affects early food and light targets, so those paired outcomes include both provisioning and routing effects.

Play one yourself

  

    
On your machine, ~/borg-play/p8-exploration-deaths has an X11 build of the same commit and four saves per death. With --to, the Borg replays from birth (checked against the zoo's keys) and hands you the window. Loading a save and pressing Ctrl-Z starts a new Borg with empty memory, so it plays a different game.

    
cd ~/borg-play/p8-exploration-deaths && ./play.sh ranger-1125613689 --to 1400

    
cd ~/borg-play/p8-exploration-deaths && ./play.sh ranger-1125613689

    
The commands follow the death selected above. Each death is also a borg-cemetery dossier (link in the header of each death).
